name: 03b-add-assistant-prefix-tools-present
description: The two guards at prompt-converters.js:71-72, both of which suppress the flag. `hasAnyTools` is true when the `tools` argument is a non-empty array OR when any message in the prompt has role `tool` -- so the second message here is what suppresses it, with `tools` null. A port that only checked the argument would set the flag and diverge. Also pins the property name: it is the caller's `property` argument, so `prefill` here versus `prefix` in fixture 03.
